First, note that time zones as we know them did not exist in 1711.  
But if we use modern time zone definitions for the sake of calculation:  

US/Eastern = UTC-5 (ignoring DST, since 1711 had no DST).  
Asia/Kolkata = UTC+5:30.  

Time difference = (5.5) - (-5) = 10.5 hours ahead.  

4:00 AM (May 10, US/Eastern) + 10 hours 30 minutes = 14:30 (2:30 PM) on May 10, 1711 in Kolkata.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1711-05-10 14:30
